notes.wmp-marker: Sets Windows Media Player's Active Setup marker, which the game checks at startup before it will run.
notes.gst-libav-overlay: Adds GameLib's sha-pinned gst-libav + LGPL FFmpeg overlay to GST_PLUGIN_PATH so CrossOver's GStreamer can decode the WMV3/WMA9 menu video and WMA8 music (spike 042).
